text:
Rowan: low-key idea  'Cozy Couch Quests' tonight in the mezz? Switch + PC fallback. thinking 8:30 start, chill playlist, short coop quests. whos in? :coffee:
Mei: count me in. ill bring my Switch and a dock. also will bring tea thermos for the squad.
Jonah: i can bring an ethernet cable (10ft) and a PS4 pad if needed. prefer wired for smaller lag.
Claire: snacks? ill bring hummus + veggie tray. also folding chair if couch full. :salad:
Dev: im down but might be late (~9pm). happy to rotate in. can bring a spare USB-A controller.
Rowan: sweet. quick poll: 8pm, 8:30, or 9pm? react :one: 8, :two: 8:30, :three: 9.
Mei: :two:
Jonah: :one: early bird here
Claire: :two:
Dev: :three: (running late tonight)
Rowan: looks like 8:30 wins. middle ground. event-bot: event created: "Cozy Couch Quests" at 2024-10-05T20:30:00Z.
Rowan: logistical notes: projector remote batteries have been an issue  bring AAA if you have spares. also bring any tiny adapters (usb-c -> hdmi) as backup.
Jonah: ill leave a cat6 on the mezz table and an extra AAA pack.
Mei: ill label my dock + put it on the left side so it doesn't vanish. last time cables wandered. :sweat_smile:
Claire: house rule: no public streams without everyones consent. local clips ok.
Dev: noted. will record locally if we want clips.
Rowan: couch plan: first 4 players get the couch, others rotate every game. bring headphones if you want muted chat.
Mei: adding a sign-up: Rowan (host PC), Mei (Switch), Jonah (wired pad), Claire (snacks). Dev (late).
Jonah: can someone bring a sticky note to mark the HDMI cable this time? ill add one to the cable.
Claire: i'll bring sticky notes + a small lamp for ambiance. soft light only after 10.
Rowan: also quick rule for controller handoff: put controller in the "handoff box" on the mezz table so its clear. saves chaos.
Dev: love the handoff box idea. will bring a tote.
Rowan: reminder: tidy commons after, throw wrappers in compost if possible. see you 8:30! :socks:
Mei: see ya! tea for anyone who wants.
Jonah: excited. bringing USB pad + cable.
Claire: brownies labeled vegan. :brownie:
event-bot: reminder: 30 minutes before event.
